name: career-skills
description: 6 Claude skills for the full job hunt — find real openings (role-finder), decode a JD with its subtext (jd-analyzer), plan what to learn (gap-planner), turn messy / spoken experience into role language (experience-mapper), polish it into résumé bullets (bullet-builder), and assemble a tailored résumé (resume-tailor). Works in Chinese or English, CS/tech-leaning, result-first. Shared red line: never invent employers, titles, numbers, awards, skills, or URLs; real jobs / JDs are fetched live, never fabricated.
